items.so_what: Director-level technology leadership and a nod to your software engineering degree, but this is hands-on product engineering rather than IT/corporate technology governance.

items.headline: Technology Operations Centre Manager — NSW Police Force, Parramatta
items.summary: An ongoing full-time role running the technology operations centre across several Sydney sites, graded at Computer Systems Officer Level 6.
items.so_what: Public-sector technology leadership is adjacent to your interests, but the grade sits below your level — noted for sector awareness rather than action.

items.headline: Manager, Technology Procurement — Commonwealth Bank, Sydney
items.summary: CommBank is hiring a manager for technology procurement.
items.so_what: Plain manager level in a procurement specialism; below target but a useful signal of CBA hiring activity.

items.headline: Senior Manager, Data Science & AI, Global Markets - Commonwealth Bank, Sydney
items.summary: CBA is hiring a senior manager to lead delivery of machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions into production for its Global Markets business.
items.so_what: Right level and right bank, but deeply quantitative and hands-on - noted for awareness of where CBA is investing rather than as a role to pursue.

items.headline: Senior Data Governance Analyst (contract) - via Enterprise Group Consulting, Sydney
items.summary: A contract role supporting implementation of a data governance framework across a large, complex organisation.
items.so_what: Data governance framework work is conceptually close to your governance background, but the analyst grade puts it well below your level.

items.headline: Manager, Office of the Chief Information Officer — Western Sydney Local Health District
items.summary: WSLHD is recruiting a manager to run the office of its chief information officer.
items.so_what: CIO office exposure in NSW Health; plain manager level and health sector, so peripheral.
